dogecoin.text: @elonmusk BIGBIGDOG is the latest virtual token, paying tribute to Dogecoin. 70% of BBG is put into the Haike Genesis Lock, 10% is put as candy, and 20% is put into the contract pool. Leave the HECO address, there will be 20 billion candies distributed
